tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm paper in light, deep river-ink in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the quota ledger rows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on surface and surface-raised (16:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, 'last verified' dates, source lines. 5.9:1 light, 8.3:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, input borders at rest.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Indus teal. The logo, primary buttons, links, focus ring. As text on surface: 5.5:1 light, 8.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills behind brand content: selected rows, recipe headers. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (6.1:1 light, 8.4:1 dark). Never ink-muted on brand.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Drift: a free tier changed, or quota is nearing its limit. Used as a FILL (badge, bar, dot) with ink text on top; never as text on surface.

tokens.name: saffron-ink
tokens.usage: Saffron-family text when a warning needs coloured words (e.g. 'changed 2 days ago'). 7.2:1 light, 11.5:1 dark on surface.

tokens.name: headroom
tokens.usage: Quota state: plenty left (> 50%). Graphic fills only (meters, dots, ≥ 3:1). Always paired with the number.

tokens.name: exhausted
tokens.usage: Quota state: 0 left, cooling down, or tier ended. Darker than headroom in light / lighter in dark so the two differ in lightness, not hue alone.

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: Quota state: provider publishes no number. Meters render as a dashed outline, never a filled bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: input wells, code chips, the alternate band behind a section.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that must stay visible: inputs on hover, the active filter chip.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and brand links.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep teal band (beta sign-up, footer CTA). Text on it is on-deep.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on brand-deep (13:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px gap in surface, then a 2px brand ring.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, gaps in a badge row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Stack-bar pitch in the pattern; ledger row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gutters between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section padding, cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, table cells, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, ledger rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, cover blocks, the app icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Badges and quota meters: the 'stack bar' shape from the logo.
